title: Quantitative measurement of viscosity in two-dimensional electron fluids
title_zh: 二维电子流体粘度的定量测量
abstract: Electron hydrodynamics is an emerging framework that describes dynamics of interacting electron systems as conventional fluids. Although evidence for hydrodynamic-like transport has been reported in a variety of two-dimensional materials, precise quantitative measurement of the core parameter, electron viscosity, remains challenging. In this work, we demonstrate that magnetoresistance in Corbino-shaped graphene devices offers a simultaneous ohmmeter and viscosometer capability, allowing us to disentangle the individual ohmic and viscous contributions to transport, even near viscous-ohmic crossover. In both monolayer and bilayer graphene, the effective electron-electron scattering rate scales linearly with temperature, deviating markedly from the T 2 dependence expected in conventional Fermi liquids. Instead, it is consistent with a recently identified tomographic fluid regime, theoretically predicted to be generic for two-dimensional electron systems.
abstract_zh: 电子水力学是一个新兴框架，将相互作用电子系统的动力学描述为常规流体。虽然在各种二维材料中已报道出类水力学输运的证据，但对核心参数电子粘度的精确定量测量仍然具有挑战性。本工作表明，科尔宾形状石墨烯器件的磁阻提供了同时作为欧姆表和粘度计的能力，使我们能够分离输运中的单纯欧姆贡献和粘性贡献，即使在粘性-欧姆转换附近也能做到。在单层和双层石墨烯中，有效的电子-电子散射率随温度呈线性增长，显著偏离于常规费米液体中预期的 T² 依赖性。相反，这与最近发现的层析流体体系一致，理论预测这种体系对二维电子系统是普遍存在的。
